addictionPotential: 无成瘾性且滥用潜力低。
summary: 一种强效迷幻色胺，存在于多种植物和部分蟾蜍毒液中，南美原住民使用历史可追溯数千年。与 DMT 及相关色胺性质相似。效力很强，与 MAOI 合用可口服有效。
effectsSummary: 5-MeO-DMT is an extremely potent psychedelic. Even low doses can produce strong visual and auditory hallucinations, altered perception of time and ego dissolution.
dosageRemark: 5-MeO-DMT is extremely potent. Respiratory and physical risks at high doses. Start very low and work up gradually.
generalRisks: Extreme increase in blood pressure and heart rate. Risk of panic attacks and psychological distress.
longtermRisks: No research results on long-term risks. HPPD possible. Psychological integration may be needed after intense experiences.
saferUse: 5-MeO-DMT can be psychologically overwhelming. A trip sitter is essential.
